screens.notes: Own top-level custom element (app-key-dates-settings-view), fourth sibling to the other three settings screens (Profesor, Ciclos/Módulos, Año académico). Master CRUD over a single shared, global table (key_dates) holding the Canary Islands' official school calendar template — day/month only, no year, not scoped per teacher, not tied to academic_years (see description_fechas-senaladas.md's "Domain and scope"). Six independent table sections (no master/detail cascade between them, unlike Ciclos/Módulos), one per key_dates.category value, each following lib/patterns/crud-table-component.md exactly like Ciclos/Módulos' tables: inline add/edit/save/cancel/delete, no modal. Deletion is always unconditional (nothing else in the schema references key_dates). Date fields are single DD/MM-formatted text inputs (not two separate day/month number pickers) — matches the source seed data's own "12/10" format and keeps rows narrow; client-side validates the DD/MM format and a real day-in-month before submit (e.g. rejects 31/02), and the backend re-validates regardless, never trusting client input alone. Seeded once from documentation/calendario_dias_clave.json (43 rows across the six categories) via src/backend/src/db/seed-key-dates.ts, auto-run on every DATA_BACKEND=postgres boot exactly like seed-catalog-curriculum.ts — not a UI feature of this screen.
